correctness.rationale: Exact finite proof for all real nonnegative scales follows from the intrinsic even/odd facet rules in arXiv:2212.05871 Lemma 2.2 and integer-floor invariance. The independent package checker reconstructs all 12 graph vertices, 18 edges, their distances and all faces, replays sequential cone-on-vertex matchings and exhaustively topologically sorts every directed Hasse graph; critical counts are (0:12), (0:1,1:7), (0:1,1:3), (0:1,2:9), (0:1,3:15,4:8), (0:1,7:5), and (0:1) at scales 0..6. The scale-four signed Morse boundary (15x8) has exact rank four and a determinant-one 4x4 maximal minor, hence four unit Smith factors; since pi_3(wedge^15 S^3) is determined by degrees, its CW complex is wedge^11 S^3 vee wedge^4 S^4. All other wedges follow from critical dimensions, and direct original-complex mod-two ranks independently agree. Inclusion H1 at scales 1->2 is surjective because every new two-distance edge bounds a triangle with an original two-edge path. Limits: only the specified graph and intrinsic ball convention; no purely numerical claim of infinite/general correctness.

originality.rationale: Compared aliases, full primary results and the closest same-graph Rips classification. The 2022 Čech article provides the construction but its higher-scale theorem is for hypercubes. Previte supplies the equivalent even-radius construction but examples/classes inspected do not include the truncated tetrahedron. A separate primary Rips paper concerns Platonic solids; the published same-graph Rips result has genuinely different homology at scale two and is contractible earlier. Multiple directed published-finding corpus and web searches for the claimed exact graph, alternate neighborhood language and all-scale barcode found no statement implying the new classification. Residual risk: an unindexed or differently named equivalent calculation.
residual_risks: Unindexed equivalent work may exist under another graph or closed-neighborhood terminology; no claim of uniqueness follows from semantic retrieval.

value.rationale: This is a natural whole-filtration classification for the symmetric twelve-vertex Archimedean truncated tetrahedron, motivated by an existing graph-metric Rips classification and the 2022 Čech program. Beyond the previously known Rips death at scale 3, the intrinsic Čech filtration has genuine mixed integral homotopy in degrees 3 and 4 at scale 4 and seven-sphere homotopy at scale 5. Exact homotopy types, a complete integer barcode, an integral unit-minor certificate and H1 inclusion proof are structural data useful in comparing nerve versus clique filtrations. This is not a trivial restatement of earlier homology or an arbitrary one-off parameter slice; no generalization to all polyhedra is claimed.
